colors.tailwind_config_instructions: Extend tailwind colors in tailwind.config.js with these exact hex codes. Set dark mode to 'class'. Map shadcn variables: --background to 050505, --card to 0A0A0B, --border to 222222, --primary to 00E676.

typography.imports: Add Google Fonts imports for Unbounded, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono in index.css.

components.name: Auth / Login Screen
components.instructions: Full viewport height. Background image with heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80). Centered Glassmorphic card (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A0A0B]/80 border border-white/10). Form inputs must have sharp edges (rounded-sm) and #121214 background.

components.name: Sidebar & Top Nav
components.instructions: Left Sidebar (w-64) for navigation between Dashboard, Spreads, Trades, Wallet, Settings. High contrast active states (border-l-2 border-primary bg-[#121214] text-white).

components.name: Bot Status & Master Controls
components.instructions: Top-level sticky widget. Must feature a massive 'Start/Stop' toggle button. When Running: Green glowing border/text. When Stopped: Red. Include 'Paper/Live' toggle switch.

components.name: Live Price Spread Table
components.instructions: Dense Shadcn Table. Font: JetBrains Mono. Columns: Symbol, Highest Bid (Exchange), Lowest Ask (Exchange), Spread %, Action. Positive spread > 0.5% highlights the row or cell in Neon Green. Use react-icons/si for exchange logos (SiBinance, SiKucoin, etc.).

components.name: Arbitrage Feed (Real-Time)
components.instructions: Vertical scrolling list of newly detected opportunities. Each item: Symbol, Buy Exch -> Sell Exch, Est Profit. Use Framer Motion for a smooth slide-down entrance.

components.name: PnL & Performance Widgets
components.instructions: Use Shadcn Cards. Flat surface, 1px border. Top row metric: Big bold JetBrains Mono number. Sub-metric: smaller gray text. Color code positive (green) and negative (red) changes.

components.name: Logs Viewer
components.instructions: Terminal aesthetic. bg-[#000000] border border-[#222]. Font: JetBrains Mono text-xs. Time in gray, INFO in green, ERROR in red, WARN in yellow. Sticky scroll to bottom.

motion_and_interactions.data_updates: Data cell background flashes softly (bg-primary/20) for 300ms when value changes.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Interactive elements lighten to bg-[#121214] with border-[#333].
motion_and_interactions.loaders: ASCII art loaders or simple monospace text '[ CONNECTING... ]' instead of circular spinners.

media_and_icons.exchange_icons: Use SiBinance, SiCoinbase, etc. from react-icons/si. If missing, use a stylized text abbreviation (e.g., [BNB], [KUC]).

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='bot-start-button', data-testid='spread-row-btc').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Unbounded, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Override Shadcn variables in global css to match the dark theme colors provided.
Do not use card components with large drop shadows; use flat colors and 1px borders.
Build the UI in React using mock data hooks (e.g., useMockSpreads, useMockLogs) before integrating actual backend APIs.
Create strict responsive grids ensuring the dashboard is dense but readable.
